A community pharmacist evaluates controlled-drug requests. The facts distinguish patient-specific prescriptions from stock orders and maintenance treatment from other indications. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.
A pharmacist resolves material diversion concerns before dispensing even when the prescriber confirms sending the prescription.
A pharmacist searches a neighbor’s controlled-drug history out of personal curiosity.
A pharmacy documents a stock-bottle distribution only as a patient prescription refill transfer.

explanation.core_reasoning: 각 선택지는 별도 기록이다. 같은 약·업무 이름보다 자격, 실제 행위, 시작점과 예외를 비교한다. 처방정보 transfer 와 약품 stock distribution 는 다른 행위·서류·기록 체계이다. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

choices.text: A pharmacist distinguishes a legitimate methadone analgesia prescription from a methadone prescription written solely for OUD maintenance outside an OTP.
A pharmacist uses the general Schedule III refill rules to bypass the depot product’s provider-delivery restriction.
A pharmacy uses a patient prescription to supply a practitioner’s general office stock.
A practitioner uses the narrow federal emergency-dispensing exception to issue renewable retail methadone maintenance prescriptions.

Prescription 은 ultimate-user 치료를 위한 주문이다. 일반 office stock 은 적법한 별도 distribution/ordering 경로를 사용한다. Methadone 의 pain prescription 과 OUD maintenance/OTP 경로는 다르다. 성분의 schedule 만으로 치료 목적별 권한을 끝내지 않는다.
